mainEntity.name: What does a typical web development project include?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical project includes discovery and planning, UI/UX design, front-end and back-end development, CMS integration, QA testing, deployment, hosting setup, performance optimization, security improvements, and analytics integration, scoped to the project's needs.

mainEntity.name: How do I determine the right type of website for my business?

acceptedAnswer.text: The right website type depends on your business goals: a conversion-focused business website for generating leads, or an e-commerce platform for selling products, chosen based on growth plans and budget.

mainEntity.name: Will my website be mobile responsive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every website is built with a fully responsive layout that works on mobile phones, tablets, laptops, and desktop screens.

mainEntity.name: How much does a project cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pricing varies based on project requirements, features, and complexity. A transparent quote with no hidden costs is provided after discussing project goals.

mainEntity.name: Will I own the source code?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Once the project is completed and payment terms are met, the client receives full ownership of the source code and project assets.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide maintenance after launch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Ongoing maintenance, bug fixes, performance optimization, security updates, and feature enhancements are available after launch.

mainEntity.name: How do I optimize websites for SEO and performance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Websites are optimized using clean code, optimized images, lazy loading, proper heading structure, schema markup, semantic HTML, fast hosting, and Core Web Vitals best practices to improve search rankings and loading speed.
